title: 2 nabbed in Surigao City illegal mining crackdown

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police and environmental authorities arrested two alleged illegal miners and seized several pieces of mining equipment during a joint crackdown on unauthorized small-scale mining in two upland villages in Surigao City on Oct. 6. The suspects were identified as Emiliano Minglana Solana, 52, of Purok 1, Barangay San Juan, and Maximino Tero Luspe Jr., 40, of Purok 11, Sitio File, Barangay Mat-i. They allegedly worked as gold panners, police said. Lt. Col.
